hook.line: While everyone is scrambling to learn Claude Code and OpenClaw, this is how to make the real money.
hook.visual: Close-up face covered by a large NVIDIA 'Certified Associate' badge, green title on top and a red '100k - 300k+/year' salary line.

beats.what: Badge, title and salary line on screen with a reply-to-comment bubble
Badge disappears; plain face with title and salary fixed on top
Lists the skills: GPU orchestration, Kubernetes, containers
Companies need deployment and inference optimization
'Ten times harder to replace' if you know the stack
Ends on the salary range, matching the top caption

why_it_works: Salary number pinned on screen the whole time, so the payoff is visible before any explanation
Contrarian framing against the crowd learning AI tools makes the viewer feel ahead of others
Replying to a viewer comment signals a real question being answered, which invites more comments
weaknesses: One static shot for 45 s with no cuts or punch-ins; only the words carry it
Dense jargon list with no visual for any term
Low loudness (-25.8 LUFS) for the platform
for_robert: Pin the one number that matters (a result or price) on screen for the whole reel, and let Fred hold or point at it instead of a static badge.
